ai_summary: Arman Financial Services Limited's FY2025-26 Business Responsibility & Sustainability Report highlights its core focus on MSME and two-wheeler finance in rural/semi-rural India. However, the report reveals critical red flags including an alarmingly high permanent employee turnover rate of 63.02% and a significant surge in customer complaints from 9 to 50, indicating potential operational inefficiencies and reputational risks. Additionally, a notable lack of gender diversity among Key Management Personnel and a subsidiary that does not participate in the parent's business responsibility initiatives are observed.
